slides.title: Business Context & Challenges
slides.speaker_notes: Set the stage: these are the pain points driving the transformation. Use specific numbers to anchor the conversation.

slides.title: Strategic Objectives
bullets: Modernize core platform to cloud-native architecture
Automate 80% of manual workflows by end of year
Unify data across all business units into single platform
Elevate customer NPS from 32 to 65+ within 2 years
slides.speaker_notes: These objectives map directly to the challenges. Each one is measurable and time-bound.

slides.title: Transformation Roadmap
slides.speaker_notes: Walk through each phase. Emphasize that phases overlap to accelerate delivery.

slides.title: Implementation Process
slides.speaker_notes: Each step has defined entry/exit criteria and an assigned workstream owner.

slides.title: Investment Allocation
slides.speaker_notes: Infrastructure and automation take the lion's share. Change management investment is critical and often underfunded.

slides.title: Projected ROI — 3-Year Forecast
slides.description: Cost savings vs. investment over 3 years
slides.speaker_notes: Payback period is approximately 22 months. Year 3 delivers 6:1 return on initial investment.

slides.title: Executive Perspective
slides.quote: Digital transformation is not about technology — it is about reimagining your business model for the next decade.

slides.title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Current state is unsustainable — action required now
Change management is foundational — not optional
